statement.zh: 萨卡拉 1912–1914 季古风马斯塔巴见 Quibell《古风马斯塔巴》（1923）。
statement.en: At Saqqara, archaic mastabas from the 1912–1914 seasons are documented in Quibell Archaic Mastabas (1923).
